anomalies.description: A large, rapidly expanding fireball and smoke plume erupts from the base of the rocket on the launch pad, indicating a catastrophic explosion during pre-launch or static fire test.

A large, rapidly expanding fireball and smoke plume originating from a launch pad structure, consistent with a catastrophic explosion of a rocket or fuel system. The blast grows in size and intensity over the sequence, engulfing the launch infrastructure.

A large, violent explosion originating at the launch pad, with rapidly expanding fireball and dense smoke; structural elements (e.g., service towers) are engulfed and appear to collapse or be torn apart during the event.

A large, sustained explosion with intense fireball, rapidly expanding smoke plume, and visible structural disintegration at a launch pad; debris is ejected (e.g., a cylindrical object seen at f6/f7), consistent with a catastrophic vehicle failure during pre-launch or static fire.

A large, sustained explosion with intense orange-yellow fireball and thick black smoke erupting from a vertical structure (likely a launch pad or rocket), progressively diminishing in intensity over the sequence.

Sustained large-scale explosion with intense fire and massive black smoke plume originating from the launch pad area; visible progression of fire intensity and smoke expansion across frames.; Sustained large-scale explosion and fire at a launch pad, evidenced by massive black smoke plume, visible flames at ground level, and structural damage to the launch tower (bent/tilted structure). The event evolves over time with smoke expanding and drifting rightward.
